# `/role-propagation-config` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### PUT /role-propagation-config/v1

`setRolePropagationConfigV1` — Update Role Change Propagation Configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint enables or disables the Role Change Propagation Process for the tenant

- Scopes: idn:role-propagation-config:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, API, HELPDESK
- Body (application/json): role-propagation-config-input
- Returns 200: role-propagation-config-response

### GET /role-propagation-config/v1

`getRolePropagationConfigV1` — Get Role Change Propagation Configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint fetches the Role Change Propagation Configuration for the tenant

- Scopes: idn:role-propagation-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, API, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: role-propagation-config-response
